completeness_rule: FULL_VIEW_REFERENCE_PROVEN means every chunk currently demanded by the pager for the held pose is resident, none are pending, fetchers are idle, and visible splats are positive. full_file_proven stays false because capture_checkpoint.js hardcodes it and these RAD files do not fit in the renderer as a whole file.
paper_grade_rule: Cross-treatment SSIM is allowed only for checkpoints whose reference repeat reaches the predeclared stability gate and whose treatment pose hash matches that reference.

gates.VIEW_CLOSURE_PROVEN: Every chunk demanded for the held pose is resident, none are pending, fetchers are idle, and visible splats are positive.
gates.REFERENCE_STABLE: An independently restarted renderer repeats the same six poses. Repeat SSIM is computed only after closure. Candidate threshold 0.995, calibrated from repeats only.
gates.FULL_VIEW_REFERENCE_PROVEN: Both gates pass. Repeat SSIM alone is not completeness.

acceleration: The reference loads once, then switches among the six frozen poses. A moved pose closes only after its demanded-chunk identity changes and every demanded page is resident. Spark's pager holds 256 pages. A pose that still demands more than 256 pages after the resident count has stayed at 256 is saved as RENDERER_CAPACITY_LIMITED and is not view closure. One reference may be reused across the three seeds of the same scene, client GPU, and renderer. A capture below 100000 bytes is not a scene image. Treatment A/B still uses the real-time trajectory.
